exposure: Two-step screening approach for GDM (50g screening followed by 100g OGTT with Carpenter-Coustan criteria)
cohort: The study participants were 1461 Chinese women with twin pregnancies delivered at a tertiary hospital in Shanghai between 2007 and 2013.
finding: The IADPSG screening method resulted in a three-fold increase in the incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus in twin pregnancies and a 38% lower risk of pre-eclampsia in non-GDM affected pregnancies compared to the two-step approach.
